secondary_metric: n_events (contiguous-run count from cdpe_sens.events.event_table; labelled, never conflated with n_cdpe_months)
timestamp_note: Source files carry mid-month timestamps (e.g. 1980-01-16); months covered are Jan 1980 through Dec 2023 inclusive.
window_note: Arm A analysed on 1980-2023, the full record of the staged SPEIbase v2.10 release (CRU TS 4.08). The published catalogue (52 events) used 1980-2024 on a different release (v2.11, CRU TS 4.09, not obtainable from this network -- DATA_MANIFEST.md sec. 1.1). This window must not be reported as 1980-2024.

baseline_check.scenario: SPEI-1, threshold 1.5, radius 4.0 deg, majority 0.5, NA gate 0.10, window 1980-2023

published.note: Published count is on 1980-2024 and a different SPEIbase release; the gap is attributed to the release/window, per DATA_MANIFEST.md sec. 1.3 -- not silently adopted.

speibase_release: v2.10 (CRU TS 4.08 based, SPEI R package 1.8.1, Jan 1901 - Dec 2023), Digital.CSIC record 10261/364137, DOI 10.20350/digitalCSIC/16497. NOTE: v2.11 (CRU TS 4.09, through Dec 2024) is listed at https://spei.csic.es/database.html but its file endpoints could not be reached from this network on 2026-10-04; v2.10 was obtained instead and the substitution is disclosed in data/DATA_MANIFEST.md. The 1980-2024 baseline check therefore runs on 1980-2023 with this release.
spi_provenance: Computed locally from CRU TS 4.09 pre (decade files, crudata.uea.ac.uk cru_ts_4.09/cruts.2503051245.v4.09/pre) with climate-indices 2.4.0 indices.spi: gamma, scale 1, calibration 1981-2010. See data/compute_spi01.py.
